definitions.row: one retired player (last season 1999..2025; players on a 2026 roster who played in 2025 are not retired)
definitions.ap: AP first-team All-Pro seasons (PFR AP1 count for drafted players; the pinned All-Pro pages for the others)
definitions.pb: Pro Bowl selections (PFR for drafted players; name presence on the pinned Pro Bowl pages for the others); NOT used by the rule
definitions.mvp opoy dpoy oroy droy sbmvp rt: AP awards, Super Bowl MVP and rushing titles from the pinned Wikipedia pages, matched by name and season
definitions.sb: Super Bowl rings, 2000 onward only: the champion's Super Bowl-week roster (ACT or INA), a season snapshot for 2000-2001
definitions.games ptd rtd ryds recy rectd sack2 dint: career totals (PFR through nflverse draft_picks for drafted players, nflverse stats_player 1999-2025 for the others); sack2 is half-sacks, dint is defensive interceptions
definitions.fgm: field goals made, nflverse stats_player 1999-2025 only (kickers who started before 1999 are short)
definitions.hof: the Pro Football Hall of Fame class year (Wikipedia list, through the Class of 2026), 0 when not a member
definitions.group: QB RB WR TE OL DL LB DB K P
definitions.active: 1 when the player has a 2026 roster row with status ACT, RES, DEV or EXE (RET and CUT rows are not active)
definitions.club birth gsis: only for last season 2016 and later (the seed candidates need them)
